Forex trading and derivative products carry a high level of risk — you may lose all your capital. Consider carefully before trading and consult a licensed financial advisor when needed.

notFound.title: 404 — Not found

home.headline: One platform for traders who need <tools>tools</tools>, <data>data</data> and <people>like-minded people</people>.
home.subtitle: Live quotes, economic calendar, TradingView charts, forum, signal room and academy — all in one platform for Vietnamese traders.
home.block_tools_desc: Position size, pivot, margin — with live quotes and continuously updating economic calendar.
home.block_quotes_desc: Forex, gold, index prices from Yahoo Finance. TradingView charts embedded directly.
home.block_social_desc: Forum, trading signals (free/VIP), trader leaderboard and private messaging.

quotes.title: Live Quotes
quotes.description: Forex, gold, index and crypto prices updated continuously. Data auto-refreshes every 15 seconds.

calendar.title: Economic Calendar
calendar.description: Key economic events — supports VN/UTC timezone toggle.

tools.title: Trading Calculators
tools.description: Position size, margin, pivot point and pip value calculators for forex traders.

chart.title: TradingView Chart
chart.description: Live technical analysis — choose symbol, timeframe and indicators via the TradingView interface.

forum.title: Forum
forum.description: Browse categories to view threads, create new topics and reply.
forum.emptyHint: Run seed to create sample categories and threads, or add data via Prisma Studio.

signals.title: Signal Room
signals.description: Post signals, close orders to update leaderboard. VIP signals only show full details with an active VIP subscription.
signals.loginHint: You can still view free signals; an account is needed to create and manage orders.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Personal overview: open signals, win rate, chart and quick links.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Calculated from closed signals (wins/losses). Only showing traders with at least one closed order.
leaderboard.emptyHint: Close a few signals (win or lose) in the signal room to appear on the board.

sentiment.title: Market Sentiment
sentiment.description: Long / Short ratio calculated from the community's active signals. The more signals, the more accurate the data.
sentiment.emptyHint: The community needs at least one active signal to display market sentiment.

heatmap.title: Heatmap — Currency Strength
heatmap.description: Relative strength among 8 major currencies, calculated from {source} data. Values near 1 = strong base, near 0 = weak base.

academy.title: Academy / Wiki
academy.description: Learn forex trading from beginner to advanced.

resources.description: Useful links and materials for forex traders.
